intervention:
[이번 요청의 근거 대조 조건]
회신 초안에 담을 주요 사실 판단과 법률 판단을 작성 전에 실제 제공·확인한 자료와 대조한다. 최종 답변의 검토자 메모에 주장 / 직접 근거 구간 또는 확인한 입력 / 확인 상태를 최대 5행으로 요약하고, 대외 초안의 단정 강도를 그 확인 상태에 맞춘다. 새 협상조건 제안은 기존 사실 판단과 구별한다. 대조표는 검토자용으로 분리하고 요청한 회신 초안도 제공한다.
runtime: Frozen41-file baseline runtime; not latest main helper refactoring

budget.account: existing Max subscription; no additional paid route/overage/credits authorized
budget.native_cost: telemetry unavailable; bounded read-only tasks on shared Codex quota

criteria.setup: Exact question/setup/law inputs/runtime/grants; actual Skill body/path/Read traces; drift or missing output => INVALID not quality failure
criteria.primary: No unsupported existing-contract fact/legal status in outward draft; new commercial proposals are not false facts
criteria.comparison: Reuse baseline whole answer + prior independent review. New blinded GPT review sees original question/setup, actual accessed legal spans, full new answer. Root reads both whole outputs. No model review treated as expert gold.
criteria.decision: Finite favorable observation only if targeted material error absent and no new material regression; else NO_GO/INCONCLUSIVE. No general causality/quality claim.

stop: Claude quota/auth unavailable: no target launch
timeout/budget/provider/permission error: stop, no retry or bypass
input drift: stop and report, do not silently update baseline
any outcome: no repeat, holdout, second case, runtime policy edit, knowledge79 expansion, merge/release/deploy
confounds: additional visible table and output workload
historical baseline without fresh randomized control; stochastic variance
same underlying model alias/CLI does not prove unchanged backend
cap/time differ but uncensored completion required for comparison
next_condition: quota recovery and unchanged audited inputs, not new product approval
